title: finding(types/spec seam): an action's `params` is declared `ActionParam[]`-only (object form refused by name) and no node-level `params` key is declared, yet `action:button`, `navigate_edit` and the published guide use an object values bag
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat #1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from objectui#7867's hand-back (dev report `5817335569`, `out_of_scope_findings` class b). It is confirmed by the seat's contract review of PR objectui#10282. ⛔ Not graded and not routed; the contract half is `domain:spec`'s to route.

## Fact: two faces disagree

**Declared:**
- `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` declares `UIActionSchema.params` (the schema type `action:button` names) as 「exclusively for user-input collection — it is always an `ActionParam[]` … a non-array value fails build validation」.
- `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0's `ActionSchema.params` says 「`ActionParam[]`, never a values map」 and refuses the object form by name.
- spec `PageComponentSchema` declares no node-level `params` key at all. Its keys are `type`, `id`, `properties`, `events`, `style` and `className`.

**Used:**
- `action:button` / `action:icon` route a non-array `params` as the values payload.
- app-shell `AppContent`'s `navigate_create` / `navigate_edit` handlers read `action.params.objectName` / `action.params.recordId`.
- `content/docs/guide/record-edit-modes.md` teaches an object `params` bag, before and after PR objectui#10282.
- objectui#7867's ruling A (params values are templates) presupposes that object bag.

⇒ The declaration refuses what the runtime and the guide use. Of the two spellings the ruling names, only `properties.params` rides a declared surface (the spec's open `properties` record).

## Seam

`spec:UIActionSchema.params` / `ActionSchema.params` (`ActionParam[]` only) → `runtime:action-button` `paramsPayload` non-array branch, app-shell `AppContent` `navigate_create` / `navigate_edit` | the guide.

## ⛔ Not claimed

⛔ Which side moves is a contract decision: declare the values bag, or retire the object form and re-home the values. The base rule is spec declaration > implementation > docs, and ⛔ this card does not pre-empt it.

## Dedupe words

`UIActionSchema params object` · `params values map` · `navigate_edit params recordId` · `ActionParam[] exclusively` · `PageComponentSchema no params key`
